title: Evaluation Chains Module
summary: This module provides various chains for evaluating the performance of language models and agents, including specialized chains for agent trajectories, QA, string comparisons, and criteria-based assessments. It also includes an orchestrator for evaluating LangChain runs and examples.

nodes.label: Evaluate Agent Trajectories
nodes.title: Trajectory Evaluation Chain
nodes.description: Evaluates the performance of ReAct-style agents by analyzing their sequence of actions, tool usage, and outcomes against a given question and reference.

nodes.label: Compare Labeled String Outputs
nodes.title: Labeled Pairwise String Eval Chain
nodes.description: Compares two string outputs (e.g., from different models or prompts) based on labeled preferences and user-defined criteria, often requiring a reference answer.

nodes.label: Evaluate Against Labeled Criteria
nodes.title: Labeled Criteria Evaluation Chain
nodes.description: Assesses model outputs against specific, user-defined criteria, requiring a reference answer for a comprehensive evaluation.

nodes.label: Evaluate QA with CoT Reasoning
nodes.title: CoT QA Evaluation Chain
nodes.description: Evaluates Question Answering systems by employing Chain of Thought (CoT) reasoning, providing a more detailed and explainable assessment of correctness.

nodes.label: Evaluate Question Answering
nodes.title: QA Evaluation Chain
nodes.description: Determines the correctness of generated answers in a Question Answering task by comparing the prediction, input query, and a reference answer.

nodes.label: Score Labeled String Outputs
nodes.title: Labeled Score String Eval Chain
nodes.description: Assigns a numerical score (typically 1-10) to a model's string output based on user-defined criteria and a provided reference answer.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Evaluation of Runs
nodes.title: String Run Evaluator Chain
nodes.description: A flexible evaluator that takes a LangChain 'Run' (LLM/Chain execution) and an optional 'Example' (dataset row), maps them to string inputs, and delegates the actual evaluation to a generic StringEvaluator.

nodes.label: Language Model (LLM/Chat)
nodes.title: Base Language Model
nodes.description: Provides core language model capabilities for generating and understanding text, serving as the underlying intelligence for many evaluation chains.

nodes.label: Prompt Template
nodes.title: Prompt Template
nodes.description: Defines the structure and content of prompts used to guide language models in various evaluation tasks.

nodes.label: Agent Tool
nodes.title: Base Tool
nodes.description: Represents a specific function or capability that an agent can utilize during its execution.

nodes.label: Parse Trajectory Output
nodes.title: Trajectory Output Parser
nodes.description: Extracts structured evaluation results, including scores and reasoning, from the raw text output of the trajectory evaluation LLM.

nodes.label: Generic String Evaluator Interface
nodes.title: String Evaluator
nodes.description: An abstract interface that defines methods for evaluating string inputs, predictions, and optional references, used by higher-level evaluators.

nodes.label: LLM Chain
nodes.title: LLM Chain
nodes.description: A fundamental chain that combines a language model with a prompt template to perform a specific task.

nodes.label: LangChain Run Object
nodes.title: Run Object
nodes.description: Represents a single execution of an LLM or a chain, encapsulating its inputs, outputs, and metadata for analysis.

nodes.label: Dataset Example
nodes.title: Example Object
nodes.description: A single data point from an evaluation dataset, typically containing an input query and a ground-truth reference answer.

nodes.label: Evaluation Result Object
nodes.title: Evaluation Result
nodes.description: A structured object containing the outcome of an evaluation, including scores, comments, and metadata.

nodes.label: Map Run to Eval Strings
nodes.title: String Run Mapper
nodes.description: Component responsible for extracting relevant string inputs (e.g., prediction, input) from a LangChain Run object for evaluation.

nodes.label: Map Example to Reference String
nodes.title: String Example Mapper
nodes.description: Component responsible for extracting the reference string from a LangChain Example object for evaluation.

groups.label: Agent Trajectory Evaluation
groups.title: Agent Trajectory Evaluation
groups.description: Components for evaluating the step-by-step execution and tool usage of AI agents.

groups.label: String Comparison & Scoring
groups.title: String Comparison and Scoring
groups.description: Chains designed for comparing and scoring model-generated text outputs, often with human-provided labels or references.

groups.label: Criteria-Based Evaluation
groups.title: Criteria-Based Evaluation
groups.description: Chains that assess model outputs against a set of predefined qualitative criteria.

groups.label: Question Answering Evaluation
groups.title: Question Answering Evaluation
groups.description: Specialized chains for evaluating the accuracy and reasoning of question answering systems.

groups.label: Evaluation Orchestration
groups.title: Evaluation Orchestration
groups.description: Components that manage the process of evaluating LangChain 'Runs' and 'Examples' by mapping them to generic string evaluators.
